title: renovation-draw
description: RFC 0081 G1 / Format §4.8. At least budget or contingency; draw group all-or-none and requires both. contingency_remaining only with draw group. CAPX-01 validates stated members; CAPX-02–04 evaluate only with draw group.

budget.description: Hard plus soft costs, excluding the contingency.

contingency_used.description: Drawn from the contingency to date. Never exceeds contingency (CAPX-02).

contingency_remaining.description: Stated and verified against contingency less contingency_used, rather than left to every reader's subtraction.

drawn_to_date.description: Total drawn, the budget line plus the contingency draw.
